title: MandateKey: on-chain spending limits for AI agent wallets
summary: Create a mandate PDA that lets an AI-agent wallet spend only inside a time window, optional destination list and per-mint caps, then revoke it.
what: MandateKey is an open spending-mandate program for AI agents on Solana. An owner initialises a mandate account (a PDA seeded by the owner's wallet, the agent pubkey and a u64 id) with a validity window, an optional co-signer, up to eight per-mint limits (per-payment and per-period caps) and an optional destination allowlist. Later, the agent signs pay, which enforces those rules in a fixed order and transfers tokens from a vault the mandate PDA owns. The owner can revoke the mandate so later payments fail. Upstream is the program and SPEC.md; the hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment.
app_note: The fork has no first-party frontend. The page at /dapps/mandatekey/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

diagram:
owner ─ create_mandate(agent, id, window, limits) ─▶ Mandate PDA ["mandate", owner, agent, id]
agent ─ pay(amount, memo) ─▶ checks window / mint / destination / caps / co-signer ─▶ vault transfer_checked
owner ─ revoke() ─▶ mandate.revoked = true  (later pay fails)
accounts: PDA `["mandate", owner, agent, mandate_id le bytes]`
The spending policy: window, caps, allowlist, revoked flag, payment_count.
The human (or treasury) that issues and can revoke the mandate.
Signer on pay; pubkey stored on the mandate
The AI-agent wallet allowed to spend under the policy.
The vault must be a token account owned by the mandate PDA. Not exercised in this run.

instructions.name: create_mandate
steps: Rejects an empty or inverted validity window, too many limits, zero period_secs, or per_payment_max > period_max.
Initialises the mandate PDA, paid by the owner, and emits MandateCreated.

instructions.name: pay
steps: Checks, in order: not revoked, inside the window, mint is listed, destination allowed, period roll-over, per-payment cap, period cap, co-signer if above threshold, vault balance.
Transfers tokens with transfer_checked, signed by the mandate PDA seeds.

instructions.name: revoke
steps: Owner-only. Sets revoked=true and emits MandateRevoked. The program does not yet close the account or withdraw the vault (those are TODOs).

innovation.title: A reusable on-chain policy for agent wallets, not a one-off allowance
innovation.text: Instead of giving an agent a raw key with no limits, the owner records a mandate the runtime itself enforces: time window, per-mint caps, optional destinations and an optional co-signer above a threshold. That is the interesting DeAI idea — agent payments with an inspectable policy — even though pay itself is a standard token transfer.
innovation.more: Milestone 1 still has TODOs: update_mandate, withdraw, close_mandate, and Token-2022 extension rejection.

frontend.title: Generic IDL console
steps: Fill create_mandate arguments; the console derives the mandate PDA from the documented seeds.
Call revoke on an existing mandate address.

exercises.title: Derive the mandate PDA yourself
steps: Use seeds ["mandate", owner, agent, mandate_id as 8 little-endian bytes] and the program id.
Compare with the address created on devnet.
exercises.expect: The address matches  the PDA from findProgramAddress.
exercises.hint: mandate_id is u64 little-endian, not a string.

exercises.title: Reason about pay without sending it
steps: Read the check order in pay.
List what happens if the mandate is revoked, if the mint is missing from token_limits, or if the destination is not allowlisted and allow_any_destination is false.
exercises.expect: Revoked, MintNotAllowed, DestinationNotAllowed in that policy order (after the window check).
exercises.hint: The comments in lib.rs number the checks 1–9.
exercises.approach: Read L73-L130 and the MandateError enum.

exercises.title: What is still missing?
steps: Find the TODO comment in lib.rs.
Name the three owner instructions that are specified but not implemented.
exercises.approach: Read the comment at the end of the program module.

not_covered: pay was not sent: it needs a mint, a vault token account owned by the mandate, and a recipient. update_mandate, withdraw and close_mandate are unimplemented. The hosted UI was not clicked in headless Chromium in this run.
objectives: Create a mandate PDA seeded by owner, agent and id, and read it back from devnet.
Explain the pay check order and why a revoked mandate cannot spend.
Revoke a mandate as the owner.
prereqs: A wallet on devnet with a little SOL (create_mandate pays rent).
Comfort with PDAs and Anchor accounts.
